name: FreeIPAPI
tagline: No-key free IP geolocation for location, timezone, currency, and ISP
description: FreeIPAPI is a free IP geolocation API that returns location, timezone, currency, and ISP details for a client IP or a queried address without requiring an API key for basic use.

auth.details: No authentication required for free endpoints; optional paid plans may use keys if offered.

use_cases: look up ISP for an IP
get currency for an IP location
